about.title: Fowler Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Fowler is a small city, but its traffic corridors carry a steady flow of commuters and farm-related traffic between Fresno and the surrounding valley. Recent public records show 28 injury collisions in a single year, with 39 people hurt and one life lost, and Thursday mornings between 7 and 9 a.m. stand out as a common time for reported crashes. Whether your collision happened on SR-99, Golden State Boulevard, or one of the northbound stretches of the freeway, the aftermath usually brings the same headaches: medical bills, missed work, and calls from an insurance adjuster asking you to explain what happened. LawProactive doesn't practice law or handle your case directly. We simply connect you, free of charge, with an independent personal injury attorney familiar with Fresno County claims, so you can focus on healing while someone else handles the paperwork and the phone calls.

whyChoose.title: Why Talk to an Attorney Before the Insurer Calls Back

items.title: California's Clock Is Running
items.desc: You generally have two years from the crash date to file a car accident lawsuit in California, but that window can shrink to as little as six months if a government entity, like a public road agency, played a role. An attorney can help you figure out which deadline applies before it's too late.

items.title: Comparative Fault Can Work Against You
items.desc: California allows recovery even if you're partly at fault, but your share of blame reduces what you can collect. Insurers know this and often try to pin more fault on you early, sometimes during that first recorded statement they ask for.

items.title: No Cap Means Your Pain Matters Too
items.desc: California places no limit on non-economic damages like pain and suffering in most car accident cases. That makes it worth having someone who can properly document how the crash affected your daily life, not just your medical bills.

items.question: Should I give a recorded statement to the other driver's insurance company?
items.answer: It's usually best to hold off. Adjusters are trained to ask questions that can shift fault onto you, and anything you say early on can be used later to reduce your claim. An independent attorney can talk to the insurer on your behalf instead.

items.question: I was hurt in a crash near SR-99 in Fowler. What should I do first?
items.answer: Get medical attention, even if injuries seem minor at first, since some symptoms show up days later. Try to preserve evidence like photos, witness names, and any dashcam footage before it disappears. Then consider getting connected with an attorney who can advise you on next steps for your specific situation.

items.question: How much does it cost to talk to an attorney through LawProactive?
items.answer: Nothing. LawProactive is a free connection service, and the independent attorneys in our network typically work on contingency, meaning they only get paid if you recover compensation. There's no upfront fee to have your case reviewed.
